note.text:
Means of transport carry people and goods from one place to another.
• By road: car, taxi, bus, motorbike, lorry, bicycle.
• By water: canoe, boat, ship, ferry.
• By rail: train.
• By air: plane, helicopter.
We say: “I go to school by taxi”, “by bus”, “by motorbike”. But: “I go on foot” or “I walk to school”.
To talk about a journey, ask and answer:
• How do you travel to Bamenda? — I travel by bus.
• How long does it take? — About one hour.
• How much is the fare? — It is one thousand francs.
Stay safe: wear a helmet on a motorbike and a seat belt in a car.

worked_example.problem: {f} asks {n} how he comes to school. {n} takes a {t} from his house. Write their short conversation.
steps: {f} asks with “How”: “How do you come to school?”
{n} answers with by + the means of transport: “I come by {t}.”
{f} asks about the time: “How long does it take?” — “About twenty minutes.”
If {n} walked, he would say “on foot”, not “by foot”.
worked_example.answer: “How do you come to school?” — “I come by {t}.”

cards.idea: Means of transport move by road, by water, by rail or by air.
example: Road: taxi, bus, motorbike. Water: canoe, ship.

cards.idea: Say “by” + the means of transport, with no a or the: by bus, by taxi, by train. But: on foot.
example: I go to school by motorbike.
Mih goes to school on foot.

cards.idea: Ask about a journey with How (which transport), How long (time), How much (money) and Where (place).
example: How do you travel to {town}? — I travel by bus.
How much is the fare? — It is one thousand francs.

questions.prompt: How does each one travel? Sort them.

misconceptions.explain: With a means of transport we say “by”: by {t.w}.
We do not say “with {t.w}”. Use by + the means of transport (but: on foot).

questions.prompt: Tap the words in the right order.
One sentence has a mistake. Which one?

right.text: We travelled to Buea by bus.
My brother rides a motorbike to work.
Ships carry goods to the port of Douala.
I walk to school every day.
Always wear a seat belt in a car.

wrong.text: I go to school by foot.
wrong.explain: We say “on foot”: I go to school on foot.

wrong.text: We travelled to Limbe on taxi.
wrong.explain: With a means of transport we say “by”: by taxi.

wrong.text: We went to Douala by the train.
wrong.explain: After by, no the: by train.
